housing.summary: Numbeo reports EUR 894.44 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Aveiro city centre, updated 29 August 2026: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Aveiro. idealista lists Aveiro rental homes at https://www.idealista.pt/arrendar-casas/aveiro/. No Aveiro-specific deposit norm was grounded.

banking.summary: Millennium bcp states that account opening requires account-opening and customer/signature forms, valid identity and taxpayer-number evidence, proof of address, and proof of professional status: https://www.millenniumbcp.pt/ajuda/contas.
required_docs: completed account-opening proposal, customer record and signature form

schools.summary: The official Região de Aveiro education portal provides a regional school-network directory at https://educacao.regiaodeaveiro.pt/. No international curriculum specifically in Aveiro city was grounded.

legal_admin.summary: EU, EEA, Andorran and Swiss nationals staying more than three months must request a registration certificate from their municipality within 30 days after the first three months: https://aima.gov.pt/pt/nacionais-ue-e-familiares/nacionais-ue/certificado-de-registo-para-nacionais-ue. Aveiro municipal customer service handles EU-citizen registration certificates: https://www.cm-aveiro.pt/servicos/gabinete-de-atendimento-integrado.
legal_admin.registration_step: If covered by the EU/EEA/Andorra/Switzerland regime and staying more than three months, request the registration certificate at Aveiro City Hall within 30 days after the first three months in Portugal.

tax_finance.summary: A foreign national can request a Portuguese NIF in person at any Tax Office or Citizen Shop with prior appointment; a legal representative can request it through the Portal das Finanças e-balcão: https://info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt/pt/apoio_ao_contribuinte/Cidadaos/Dados_pessoais_familia/Dados_pessoais/NIF/Paginas/default.aspx.

transport.summary: Aveiro Bus publishes a EUR 15 zone-1 monthly urban pass at https://www.aveirobus.pt/gama-tarifaria. Driving-licence rules depend on the issuing country; qualifying OECD/CPLP licences may remain valid under the listed conditions and optional exchange is available through IMT at https://www.imt-ip.pt/condutores/reconhecimento/troca-de-titulo-de-conducao-estrangeiro/cartas-de-conducao-emitidas-pelos-paises-da-ocde-e-cplp/. Foreign nationals receive an SNS user number on first attending a public health unit, as described at https://www.gov.pt/servicos/pedir-o-numero-de-utente-do-sns, and can register at a local health centre with that number: https://www.gov.pt/servicos/inscrever-se-no-centro-de-saude.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Rules depend on the issuing country. Qualifying OECD/CPLP licence holders may drive in Portugal while IMT conditions remain satisfied; they may optionally exchange through the A Minha Carta de Condução portal.
transport.healthcare_registration: A foreign newcomer receives an SNS user number on first attending a public health unit such as a health centre or hospital, then can register at the local health centre using that number.
